transcript: Speaker A: I am in proximity to the bus stop. It means very close. Not far. I am in the vicinity of the market. It means near this area. Around here. I am adjacent to the building. Adjacent means right next to. I walk abreast of my friend. Abreast means side by side. I walk alongside the road. Alongside means next to something while moving. It is over and above the box. It means higher than. Above something. I stand up against the wall. Up against means touching or very close. The road is parallel with the river. Parallel means same direction, side by side.
